title: That Corgi called me the rubber band Doxie
text: Bart: That Corgi called me the rubber band Doxie https://t.co/M13Tq788Eq
blurb: Bart, a gray-muzzled doxie perched on a rumpled bed, is giving the camera some serious side-eye. According to Bart, a Corgi called him "the rubber band Doxie," and he has clearly not let it go.
